程序包 com.ta.recruitment.model

类 Application

java.lang.Object
com.ta.recruitment.model.Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents a TA's application for a job posting.

Status values: "pending" (awaiting MO review), "accepted", "rejected". AI analysis fields are populated asynchronously by GeminiService after submission.
